# Defensive Cyber

> Defensive Cyber is a premier technical cybersecurity firm delivering principal-led penetration testing, digital forensics, cyber threat intelligence, incident response, and low-level reverse engineering.

## Capabilities & Services
- [Digital Forensics](https://defensive-cyber.com/service/digital-forensics): Live memory analysis, filesystem artifacts, and court-admissible forensic reporting.
- [Cyber Threat Intelligence](https://defensive-cyber.com/service/cyber-threat-intelligence): Proactive dark web surveillance, actor profiling, and detection engineering.
- [Incident Response](https://defensive-cyber.com/service/incident-response): 24/7 rapid containment, adversary eradication, and resilient operational recovery.
- [Reverse Engineering & Malware Analysis](https://defensive-cyber.com/service/reverse-engineering-malware-analysis): Binary disassembly, payload unpacking, and C2 disruption.
